_comment: Serving latency baseline, M-series Mac, flex backend, english checkpoint, 20 repeats. q8 = model.q8.mpk (block-scaled Q8, eager-dequantized at load); f32 = safetensors. Weights are dequantized at load, so compute is identical and the two rows differ only by noise.

multilingual_zh_cn._comment: mmBERT-base route (router auto-routes zh utterances), MASSIVE zh-CN 100 cases. f32 = safetensors, q8 = model.q8.mpk 377MB pack. No official reference number exists for the multilingual checkpoint (official sweep part_b is english-only); parity is anchored by the PyTorch reference comparison in the commit.
